map.水草按光需求分三级：低光约 20 至 40 μmol/(m²·s) 或 0.3: Aquatic plants fall into three light levels: low light about 20 to 40 μmol/(m²·s) or 0.3 to 0.5 W/L (shade plants such as moss and ficus); medium light about 40 to 80 μmol or 0.5 to 0.8 W/L (such as crown lettuce); high light above 80 μmol or 0.8 to 1.2 W/L (such as dwarf pearl and red butterfly); 6 to 10 hours of light per day, and the stronger the light the more CO₂ and liquid fertilizer are needed to prevent algae outbreaks.

map.📚 深度解析：水草光照需求分类: 📚 Deep Dive: Aquatic Plant Light Requirement Classification
map.按水草对光照的强弱需求（低/中/高三档）选配合适灯具功率，避免光不足徒长或过强爆: Pick plants by how much light they need (low / medium / high) so the lighting wattage matches, avoiding etiolation from too little light or algae from too much.
map.按缸内实际水体升数乘以单位功率需求，反算所需灯具总瓦数。: Multiply the actual liters of water in the tank by the required unit power to work back to the total wattage of the lamp needed.
map.入门时优先选低光阴性草（水榕、莫斯、铁皇冠），降低设备与 CO2 门槛。: When starting out, prefer low light shade plants (anubias, moss, java fern) to lower the barrier for equipment and CO2.
map.光照档位（W/L，每升水体所需瓦数）：低光 0.3–0.5、中光 0.5–0.8: Light tiers (W/L, watts needed per liter of water): low 0.3-0.5, medium 0.5-0.8, high 0.8-1.2. Total power (W) = actual volume (L) × target tier value. Low light shade plants: anubias, java fern, java moss, cryptocoryne, small water plantanther, bolbitis; medium light: green ludwigia, neon tetra grass, water sprite, Nymphaea, small hygrophila; high light: pearl grass and similar (which need CO2 and fertilizer).
map.100 L 水体的草缸：养低光阴性草取 0.4 W/L → 需 40 W；养中光: A 100 L planted tank: low light shade plants at 0.4 W/L → 40 W needed; medium light at 0.6 W/L → 60 W; a high light foreground carpet at 1.0 W/L → 100 W, which must be matched with CO2 and liquid fertilizer or algae will bloom.
map.高光为什么必须加 CO2？: Why does high light require CO2?
map.强光下水草光合作用旺盛，碳源成为限制因素；CO2 不足时水草生长受抑而藻类趁虚爆: Under strong light plants photosynthesize vigorously and carbon becomes the limiting factor; without enough CO2 plant growth is held back while algae take over, so high light tanks usually pair CO2 with regular fertilizing.
map.阴性草真的不需要强光吗？: Do shade plants really need no strong light?
map.阴性草在低光下可存活并缓慢生长，但长期过暗会徒长、叶色变淡；给到中低光（0.3–: Shade plants survive and grow slowly in low light, but staying too dark for long makes them etiolated with pale leaves; giving them low to medium light (0.3-0.5 W/L) suits them best and keeps equipment demands low.
